title: Autonomous agent: merge / version (CONFIRM)
description: Merge current PR and optionally bump version. Requires confirm=CONFIRM.
goalTemplate:
SHIP step of the Companion autonomous workflow for repositories {{repositories}}. User confirm token: {{confirm}}. Do bump: {{doBump}}. Bump part: {{bumpPart}}.

1) `ncc ai workflow status --workspace <id> --json`
2) ONLY if {{confirm}} is exactly CONFIRM: `ncc ai workflow merge --workspace <id> --confirm CONFIRM --strategy {{mergeStrategy}}`
3) If doBump=yes AND confirm is CONFIRM: `ncc ai workflow bump --workspace <id> --confirm CONFIRM --part {{bumpPart}}`
4) If confirm is not CONFIRM: refuse.
Never force-push. Never invent confirm.

params.label: Confirm token
params.description: Must select CONFIRM to allow merge/bump.
